page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at the top; below them a calendar table with three columns (month and date at left, Dies column, THAMVS column with the Sabbath and fast-day entries); a right-hand marginal note beside the table; catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.head: מנה Mensis decimus.
10. THAMVS di. 29.
main_text.p: Quartus in anno sacro. Character ejus hoc anno. 2. 20. 281.17. franguntur tabulae Legis. Epistemon cremat librum Legis. Ponit statuam in templo.

page.notes: Right-hand note is set in the margin beside the table; the Hebrew word in the running head line is printed as shown. Faint show-through from the facing page (Julian-calendar columns and text) is ignored. The "1637." year and "Quartus in anno sacro" are printed as set in the table, with the italic "Character ejus hoc anno." and the italic "Sabbathum." and "Iejunium." entries.
